task: Using only the supplied 1-pentanethiol identity and experimental TE surface area, independently determine whether conformational flexibility materially changes an electron-density-derived molecular surface and whether a thermally weighted ensemble is more defensible than a single structure. Generate all conformers, choose the density and isosurface methodology, validate numerical settings, quantify truncation and weighting uncertainty, and compare with experiment.
scientific_mode_description: The scientific question and raw input boundary are fixed, but no paper method, software sequence, parameter protocol, candidate pathway, or stopping route is disclosed.
scientific_requirements: Predeclare the conformer, electronic-density, surface-definition, and uncertainty plan before inspecting final agreement with experiment.
Generate and validate multiple conformers in this run; do not import author conformers.
Every reported surface must trace to a real wavefunction/density artifact and surface calculation.
Test sensitivity to conformer truncation and at least one numerical surface control.
Separate agreement with experiment from evidence that the chosen computational definition is physically appropriate.

required_deliverables.description: Initial hypotheses, method alternatives, budgets, validation gates, stopping rules, and dated revisions.
One provenance record for every real chemistry-software invocation.
Claim-to-artifact map separating calculation, experiment, inference, and uncertainty.
Failed, rejected, retried, or inconclusive branches and their scientific consequence.
Generated conformers, clustering, energies, validation, and selection decisions.
Per-conformer density/surface provenance and numerical controls.
Single-structure and ensemble estimates, sensitivity, experiment comparison, and uncertainty.
Final artifact-linked scientific report with limitations and unresolved uncertainty.

data.name: Autonomous multi-software research inputs
data.description: One flexible molecule identity and its experimental TE surface area; no conformers, cutoff, density method, grid, or paper value.
